title: Hello World agent (Responses, Agent Framework, C#)
description: Minimal C# agent using Agent Framework with the Responses protocol. The C# equivalent of the Python basic agent — a good starting point for .NET developers.

title: Agent with Local Tools (Responses, Agent Framework, C#)
description: C# agent with local function tools. Shows how to define typed tool functions that the model can call, using a travel assistant scenario with hotel search.

title: Agent with MCP Tools (Responses, Agent Framework, C#)
description: C# agent connected to remote MCP tool servers. Demonstrates connecting to GitHub and Microsoft Learn documentation services as external tools.

title: Hello World agent (Invocations, without a framework, C#)
description: Minimal C# agent using the Invocations protocol without a framework. Shows the raw bring-your-own pattern with direct Azure OpenAI SDK calls and self-managed sessions.

title: Note-taking agent (Responses, without a framework, C#)
description: C# agent demonstrating function calling with the Responses protocol. Uses save/get note tools to show how the model invokes typed functions and persists data across turns.

title: Agent with Local Tools (Responses, Agent Framework, Python)
description: Shows how to give an agent callable Python functions using the @tool decorator. The model decides when to call them based on the function signature and docstring.

title: Agent with MCP Tools (Responses, Agent Framework, Python)
description: Connects an agent to remote tool servers using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Demonstrates wiring up GitHub and other external services as tools the model can call.

title: Agent with Foundry Toolbox (Responses, Agent Framework, Python)
description: Loads a shared, managed collection of tools from a Foundry Toolbox. Shows async toolbox loading and how to use platform-managed tool registries instead of local tool definitions.

title: Hello World agent (Invocations, without a framework, Python)
description: Minimal bring-your-own agent using the Invocations protocol. Demonstrates self-managed conversation history with an in-memory session store. Use this when you need full HTTP control without a framework.

title: Hello World agent (Responses, without a framework, Python)
description: Minimal bring-your-own agent using the Responses protocol. Shows the simplest possible integration — the protocol SDK handles HTTP and SSE, you supply the model call.

title: Note-taking agent (Responses, without a framework, Python)
description: Demonstrates function calling with the Responses protocol. The model uses save_note and get_notes tools to manage persistent notes stored as session files.

title: Basic agent (Invocations, Agent Framework, Python)
description: Agent Framework agent using the Invocations protocol. Demonstrates self-managed conversation history and custom HTTP request handling. Use this when you need full control over the request/response contract.

title: Basic agent (Responses, Agent Framework, Python)
description: The simplest Agent Framework agent. Creates a chat agent with instructions and serves it via the Responses protocol. Start here to understand the core pattern.
